anna: Heads-up — onboarding call with EdgeSense (hardware partner) today revealed their devices report cumulative counters in bursts (often after days offline). This will complicate marketplace usage mapping. Need quick alignment on dedup/reconciliation and entitlement proration.

mike: Can you paste a sample payload? Are there seqnums or monotonic counters?

sanjay: They send device_id, total_seconds, ts, and a signature. No guaranteed ordering from connectivity. Counters can reset on power-cycle. Example payload they sent: ```json
{"device_id":"es-123","total_secs":452000,"ts":"2026-03-20T14:22:00Z","reset_flag":false,"event_id":"evt-9f2b"}
```

lisa: SRE concern: bursts + partner retries might double-report. We'll need idempotency, dedupe window, and strong observability.

mike: Proposal: require partner to include event_id + monotonic_seq (when available) + reset_flag. If device reports counter < last_seen_counter and reset_flag is false, mark for manual review or hold-back until next sample. Also require HMAC signature so we can validate origin.

anna: Marketplace mapping note: device-level usage should map to SKU=embedded-hour. Finance wants deterministic mapping per UTC day. How do we handle timezone-local devices that report local-midnight resets?

sanjay: Normalize timestamps to UTC on ingest and compute per-device watermarks. Ingestion pseudocode: 
```
last = db.get(device_id).last_seen_counter
if incoming.event_id in db.seen_event_ids: return // idempotent
if incoming.total_secs >= last:
  delta = incoming.total_secs - last
elif incoming.reset_flag:
  delta = incoming.total_secs // device reset, treat as fresh usage window
else:
  enqueue_for_recon(incoming) // out-of-order or possible rollover
record_usage(device_id, delta, incoming.ts)
```
We also store last_seen_ts and last_seen_counter per device.

mike: For contracts we should mandate event_id, device_tz, reset_flag, monotonic_counter if available, and a signed_hash. Also define late-arrival TTL (30 days) for backfills. Legal ok with requiring signed events? @anna

anna: I'll loop in legal. For immediate rollout, can we implement a nightly reconciliation job to detect negative deltas and auto-correct credits within a 7-day backfill window? Who can own that job?

lisa: I can own the nightly job infra. Need a clear spec and test vectors. Metrics: alert when >0.5% devices have unresolved negative deltas for >24h.

sanjay: I'll scope ingestion changes, schema extension, and tests. Plan: canary deploy ingestion pipeline with new schema for 2 weeks, surface per-device watermarks in Console.

mike: Sounds good. Action items: @sanjay update spec + PR, @lisa build recon job + alerts, @anna own partner contract language + legal, @mike implement billing mapping + queries. ETA 2 weeks? :calendar: 

anna: Thanks — pinging EdgeSense on the call notes and sample payload requirements. Will post meeting recording + payload examples. :email:
